input: What is the difference between Mobile-ID and Smart-ID?
expected_output: Mobile-ID is SIM card-based and works on devices where the SIM card is located, requiring a special SIM card from mobile operators with a monthly fee (typically 1 euro). Smart-ID is a mobile app that works independently of SIM cards, is free to use, and can be installed on any smart device with internet connection.
retrieval_context: Mobile-ID is SIM card-based and works on devices where the SIM card is located and can be transferred from one device to another. Smart-ID is a mobile app and works independently of SIM cards on the device where it is installed.
Mobile-ID monthly fee is usually 1 euro. Smart-ID application download and use is free for everyone.

Smart-ID - это мобильное приложение, которое работает независимо от SIM-карт, бесплатно в использовании и может быть установлено на любое умное устройство с интернет-соединением.
retrieval_context: Mobile-ID is SIM card-based and works on devices where the SIM card is located. Smart-ID is a mobile app and works independently of SIM cards on the device where it is installed.
Mobile-ID monthly fee is usually 1 euro. Smart-ID application download and use is free for everyone.

input: How do I create a Smart-ID account?

Step-by-step instructions are displayed on screen, and once registered, you can immediately start using Smart-ID.

input: What happens if I enter my Smart-ID PIN code incorrectly three times?
expected_output: If you enter your Smart-ID PIN code incorrectly three times, your account will be blocked for three hours. If this happens multiple times, the second time your account will be locked for 24 hours, and the third time it will be locked permanently. PIN codes cannot be changed or restored for security reasons.
retrieval_context: If you have entered your PIN codes incorrectly three times, your account will be blocked for three hours.
If this happens multiple times, the second time your account will be locked for 24 hours and the third time permanently. PIN codes cannot be changed or restored for security reasons.
